title: Sequence-diversity-guided discovery, model-guided mutagenesis, and secretory production of GH5 endoglucanases in Bacillus subtilis
summary: Sequence-model-guided selection plus direct biochemical assays establishes previously uncharacterized active GH5 enzymes and production result. Explicitly preserve imperfect predictions, purified/flask scale and no industrial deployment claim.
